decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core pipeline offering for existing customers, it likely meets or comes close to aspiration levels and is easy to carry with available production and sales resources.

This waste-bin product is relatively distant from the firm's core infrastructure business, so if its results are merely average or uncertain management is likely to reallocate resources to better-performing core products or nearer developments.

Although the firm can make and coat this product and it may reach some municipal buyers, its distance from the main product-market focus makes it more vulnerable if performance falls short of aspirations.

Outdoor public ashtrays use relevant fabrication capabilities but sit outside the firm's main technical and commercial focus, so boundedly rational management would likely prune them if they do not clearly justify continued attention.
